headline: Rotary Club voted to be the sole sponsor for the Exit 4 welcome sign.
summary: Talks covered repairs to sponsor signs and fundraising ideas, including a painted-rock scavenger hunt and gift certificates to local restaurants. Low turnout at the fall cleanup was also discussed, and donations can now be made through PayPal.

decision_titles: Sole sponsor for Exit 4 welcome sign
plain_text:
Beautify Londonderry Committee 
Minutes 10/20/2026 
Sunnycrest Room - Town Hall, 7 PM 
  
 
  
I. Call to order. 7:05 pm, Attendance John Mahon, John Loker, Beth Murray, 
Joy Fraga Muller 
  
II. Public comment – none present 
 
III. Approval of September meeting minutes.  Beth motioned, John L 
second, all approved.  
 
IV. Welcome to Londonderry Signs  
 
- Update on Sponsor Signs. 2 posts are in place and may need to be 
repainted.  For the sponsorship signs.  And mounting hardware will be 
needed.  We should be using stainless steel bolts so can hold up in the 
weather.   
 
- John M. asked for approval to go out for quotes on making new 
sponsorship signs.  He did check that the coloring of the gold is reflective.     
 
V. AI Fundraising Ideas Discussion 
 
- J. Mahon used ChatGPT to ask for ideas on how we may raise money.  
Tasked with looking at other ideas for similar fundraising around the region.  
Committee discussion on the ideas centered around making sure we don’t 
double up.  Committee thought about the potential for a few ideas: 
o Community night at a brewery/food trucks social. 
o Scavenger hunt of painted rocks at the town commons. Beth will 
come up with a quick write up.  
▪ Can we have the scouts do rock-painting and they can hide 
around town? 
• Just in the town forest?  May be hard for families to go to 
multiple places.  We have food trucks. Kids that turn in 
rocks would get a prize.  
o Gift certificates to local restaurants.  
NEXT MEETING  
Tuesday November 17, 2026; 
7:00 PM Sunnycrest Room, Town 
Hall
▪ Musquash with tree identification. 
 
- Letter discussion will be postponed until next meeting.  
 
VI. Fall Clean-Up Review and Discussion 
- J. Mahon opened up the discussion that we have had poor turnout for the 
fall.  Can we take the effort that we have been putting in the fall cleanup 
into a different way? The committee discussed several ideas: 
o Scavenger hunt 
o Advertising was similar to last years/spring.  In addition, in the 
electronic newsletters to the school. 
o The sponsor-a-road fall cleanups were also down in volunteer 
number.   
o Neighborhood group “battles of the bag” to get the most people out 
cleaning together.  
o Can we recognize those people who are regularly going out on their 
own? 
▪ Trash Ambassadors for Beautify Londonderry 
▪ Also give a way to contact for problem areas around town.  
▪ Maybe we do a story about them once a month on our Beautify 
Londonderry page.   
 
VII. Fall Sponsor-a-road wrap-up.  
  
- Fall Sponsor-A-Road Schedule. All groups have gone out. 
o Admix Oct 7 
o WINWaste Oct 17 
o Bosch Oct 7 
o WM Oct 17 – 18 bags, 3 people; Liberty Drive they will alternate 
with Trend Moving & Storage (spring) 
o Football team will come on board again in Spring.  
 
VIII. New Member ideas?  
J. Mahon put out to Facebook.  We haven’t had any people step forward. 
Think about for next meeting.  
 
IX. Good News 
- J. Mahon presented to the Rotary Club and they have voted to be the 
sole sponsor for the Exit 4 sign. J. Mahon is getting in contact with the 
state to see what is needed to put this welcome sign on the plot of land 
between the exit areas.
- PayPal is working for donations!  J. Mahon worked with town and has the 
protocol/directions for finding the Beautify Londonderry – Town of 
Londonderry account from a phone/account. 
 
X. Public comment. None present.  
  
XI. Round table discussion. None.  
  
XII. Meeting adjournment.  7:52 pm; J. Loker motion, B. Murray second, 
committee all approved.  
  
Action items: 
Beth:  
1. Look into community night at a brewery and will do a write-up potential scavenger 
hunt in town forest.   
John M:  
1. Get quote for new sponsorship signs and stainless-steel bolts. 
2. Contact follow up with state for moving forward with Exit 4 signs.  
All:  
1. Ideas for recruitment of committee members.  
  
2026 Meeting Dates: 3rd Tuesday of the month at 7pm

Minutes prepared by Beautify Londonderry Secretary Joy Fraga Muller
